name: Margo Kess
distinction: A virtual-reality spider-hero from Earth-22191. Her last name was attached after the debut story, ahead of the film.
summary: Margo Kess protects a world that lives online, fighting as the avatar Spider-Byte. She debuted in Vault of Spiders #1 during Spider-Geddon. Amandla Stenberg voices her in Across the Spider-Verse.
creators: Nilah Magruder and Alberto Jiménez Alburquerque.
